tokens.kind: USD₮0 (USDT0), the omnichain form of Tether USD: an upgradeable proxy whose tokens are minted and burned on this chain by its OFT contract against USDT locked in the OFT Adapter on Ethereum (LayerZero messaging). Not the Ethereum USDT contract, and not named on Tether's own page. The contract's symbol is "USD₮0"; the tools' key is USDT0. Its owner can block an address and destroy a blocked balance

tokens.label: USD₮0
tokens.note: USD₮0 is USDT0, the cross-chain form of Tether USD (LayerZero). It is not the USDT contract of Ethereum.

behaviour.issuerPowers: An upgradeable proxy (admin 0x553ec478A66BE27Ba25A6bc5dB20AEc2eD6A1B4A when read): its code can be replaced, which the pinned hash of the proxy does not show. The owner (the Safe 0x4DFF9b5b0143E642a3F63a5bcf2d1C328e600bf8 of the publisher's list) can block an address and destroy its balance; the OFT contract mints and burns. Its value rests on the USDT locked on Ethereum and on the cross-chain messaging.

checked.how: the functions the implementation (0x3263CD783823d04a6B9819517E0E6840d37cA3F4, code 0x1d4c20a1a19a0e182c0d2bffbe433a96bd70a1dbb383b7a2d293976df4042279) dispatches on (PUSH4 scan: isBlocked, addToBlockedList, destroyBlockedFunds, mint, burn, oftContract; no pause and no fee function); on a loopback fork: transfer, approve and transferFrom return true, approve from 5 to 7 succeeds, transferFrom of 3 received as 3

confirmation.revertedWhy: The safe block's batch is posted on Ethereum in a block Ethereum calls safe: replacing it needs an Ethereum reorganisation past a justified checkpoint. Measured 2026-11-17: 8 to 9 minutes behind the head.
confirmation.residualRisk: settle: a sequencer reorganisation deeper than 32 blocks (about 10 s); as OP Mainnet. strict: the chain's finalized tag.

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 0.1 ETH and its USD₮0 at the market price: the same floor as this chain's first pair, for the same reason (gas is negligible here; the floor keeps the pool worth more than a few hundred dollars a side). Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.

quoteStandsFor.reason: Chainlink publishes no feed for USD₮0 itself; it is redeemable one for one for the USDT locked on Ethereum, so the USDT feed stands for it. The second reference prices USD₮0 itself: if it left the price of USDT, the two would part and the tool would refuse.

reserveCapsReason: No caps (coordinator's technical decision, 2026-11-17): an ordinary constant-product exchange. The caps exist on the Bloch L2 to bound what a fault of the bridge can drain through a pool of a bridged asset; the assets listed here are the chain's own native coin and a token issued on this chain, so that risk does not exist, and a pool capped on both sides would leak its fees to whoever calls skim first (docs/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY.md section 2).
